{"requirements": [
{"id": 1, "text": "The game shall support three players."},
{"id": 2, "text": "Each player's initial points shall be 0."},
{"id": 3, "text": "The game shall alternate turns among the players."},
{"id": 4, "text": "In each turn, the current player shall throw a dice."},
{"id": 5, "text": "The sum of the dice count shall be added to the current player's points."},
{"id": 6, "text": "After each turn, the system shall display the dice count and the current player's points."},
{"id": 7, "text": "The game shall end after exactly 12 turns."},
{"id": 8, "text": "The game shall terminate if one player's points are at least 2 times the average of all players' points."},
{"id": 9, "text": "If the dice count is 1, the current player shall be prompted to re-roll the dice."},
{"id": 10, "text": "The system shall display a congratulatory message for the winner."},
{"id": 11, "text": "The point colors for players 1, 2, and 3 shall be red, green, and blue, respectively."},
{"id": 12, "text": "If a player's points are sufficient to win, their point color shall turn purple."},
{"id": 13, "text": "If the current player throws a 6, their turn shall end immediately."},
{"id": 14, "text": "If the dice count is 2, it shall be tripled; if it is even, it shall be halved."},
{"id": 15, "text": "The game shall check the players' points at any point in the game and print 'Equality!' if they are equal."},
{"id": 16, "text": "The players' turn order shall be determined at the beginning of the game."},
{"id": 17, "text": "The system shall prompt for player names and reject 'Computer' as a valid name."},
{"id": 18, "text": "If the dice count is high, the current player shall re-roll the dice and multiply both dice counts."},
{"id": 19, "text": "If a player's points exceed 5, their point color shall turn purple."},
{"id": 20, "text": "In each turn, the current player shall have the option to skip their turn."},
{"id": 21, "text": "If a player throws the same value multiple times in a row, their points shall be reset to 0."},
{"id": 22, "text": "If two players have the same amount of points, the game shall not terminate until one player has more points than the other."},
{"id": 23, "text": "After the game has ended, the system shall display the players' points and the winner."},
{"id": 24, "text": "After the game has ended, there shall be a single winner."},
{"id": 25, "text": "If the players choose to play again, the players shall be ordered in the same way as the previous game."}
]}
